name: @patdown/claude
description: Claude Code plugin that judges Write/Edit against patdown rules before they hit disk

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs build && printf 'content package: no build.\n'
scripts.check: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs lint && printf 'content package: no TypeScript to lint.\n'
scripts.typecheck: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs typecheck && printf 'content package: no TypeScript to typecheck.\n'
